omar_oncall: Evening handoff — quick incident summary
omar_oncall: Timeline: started ~1788880000 (≈45m ago). Pagerduty routed to me. Symptoms: intermittent 503s on /v1/embeddings and increased tail latency on embeddings-p95.
omar_oncall: Root cause (current hypothesis): KV cache eviction storm on shard-gpu-12 causing request stalls; autoscaler/queue fallback sends requests to embed-large (higher mem) and we exhausted token-batcher threads.
pagerduty-bot: INC0012345 triggered: 503 spike detected on service=redwood-embed region=us-west-2 severity=page
Aisha M.: Saw the same. Logs show many "kv/evict" churn messages and pod restarts ~1788879800.
Kenji: Confirmed. Eviction rate jumped from ~20/s to ~800/s after a burst of traffic from customer "syncstream". Could be an input pattern with many short prefixes.
Sophie: Are we still able to serve a fallback embedding model (embed-small) with acceptable quality? We should route noisy tenants to fallback ASAP.
omar_oncall: Implemented temporary routing: noisy tenants -> embed-small, standard -> embed-medium. Also applied soft throttle at edge for syncstream (50% throttle) to reduce pressure.
infra-ci: Autoscaler note: removed 1 replica on shard-gpu-12 due to OOM loop; current desired=8 actual=7. Scaling event at ~1788880300.
Aisha M.: Can someone paste the runbook snippet? I don't want to hunt.
omar_oncall: Runbook pointers: 1) /runbooks/kv-eviction-throttle 2) /runbooks/fallback-model-routing. Quick commands I used:
```
# throttle a tenant at the edge
redctl throttle tenant syncstream --rate=0.5 --reason "evening eviction storm"
# route tenant to fallback model
redctl route tenant syncstream --model embed-small --duration=30m
```
Sophie: Thumbs on quality: embed-small p95 decreases a bit but acceptable for batching; we should schedule an eval later. :thumbsup:
Kenji: Current metrics: p95 latency embeddings overall 820ms -> 420ms after throttle/reroute. 503s dropped from 6.2% -> 0.7% in 12m. Error budget still at risk if traffic returns.
omar_oncall: Open action items for handoff:
- Primary: Kenji (on-call) — continue monitoring shard-gpu-12 and confirm autoscaler health.
- Secondary: Aisha M. — own customer comms if we need to notify syncstream SLA.
- SRE: Sophie — follow up with model-quality eval for embed-small routing.
- Next: schedule warmup of two spare replicas in us-west-2 for embed-medium to reduce cold start risk.
Kenji: I'm primary. I'll keep an eye on evict rate, queue depth, and pod restarts.
Aisha M.: I'll draft a short customer-facing note if we need to escalate. Suggest: "We've mitigated a performance regression by temporarily rerouting traffic; investigating root cause; will follow up in 2h."
Sophie: I'll run a quick eval job against the affected prompt set (syncstream-sample) and share numbers in #eng-ml within 30m.
omar_oncall: Notes on potential follow-ups for next 24h:
- Investigate cause of eviction spike: input distribution vs kv config regression.
- Consider increasing kv-cache size or adjusting eviction policy for shard-gpu-12.
- Postmortem owner: TBD (assign after stabilization).
infra-ci: Alert: new job scheduled to add 1 replica to preferred pool at 1788884200 (automated warmup).
Kenji: Observability checklist I'm monitoring:
- grafana/dashboard/embeddings -> p50/p95/p99, 503 rate, batcher queue depth
- logs -> "kv/evict", "oom" patterns, pod restarts
- redctl routes -> verify no tenant accidentally routed to embed-large
omar_oncall: If anything spikes back up, page the primary immediately. If primary is unavailable, page the on-call rotation per PD rules.
Sophie: Leaving a quick how-to for rolling a pod safely (if we need to drain shard):
```
# cordon node
kubectl cordon gpu-node-12
# drain but keep graceful period
kubectl drain gpu-node-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120
# watch pods come back and ensure evict rate falls
```
Aisha M.: Anything else for handoff?
Kenji: I'll keep update cadence every 15m for next hour, then every 60m if stable. First update at +15m from now.
omar_oncall: Thanks all — handing off. Current status: mitigated (partial), monitoring, primary=Kenji, secondary=Aisha M., SRE owner=Sophie. Last note: ticket created ENG-INC-4521 with root cause hypothesis; add notes to ticket as you triage. Good luck.
Sophie: :thumbsup: adding eval link to the ticket.
pagerduty-bot: Reminder: If escalation needed, use /pd escalate ENG-INC-4521 to oncall-manager.
Kenji: Received. Handoff complete.
